question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party and People’s Liberation Army underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against his removal before the 2027 Party Congress. Ongoing purges of senior military officers and Politburo figures through mid-2026 have eliminated potential rivals without producing visible opposition or factional revolt, while no designated successor has emerged and institutional norms favor continuity for the 73-year-old leader. Analysts across sources expect him to secure a fourth term at the October or November 2027 congress, deferring succession questions until at least 2032. Although sudden health developments or an unprecedented elite backlash remain theoretically possible, current elite dynamics and the absence of credible alternatives sustain the strong market pricing for his continued tenure.
